attchmntText: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Solex Energy Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 post-earnings conference call held on November 14, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and the Bombay Stock Exchange Limited. Chairman and Managing Director Chetan Shah stated that the company has resumed 24/7 operations and expects to meet revenue guidance within the next 4.5 months. The firm reported no warranty claims to date, with coverage provided by Munich Re. Management indicated that the cell line project has cleared land and environmental clearances, with groundbreaking expected soon. Commercial production of the Tapi RQ Quarter Cell Module is targeted for December 2027 following certification. The company continues regular exports to the Middle East, Africa, and Europe, while evaluating potential manufacturing facilities in the United States.

attchmntText: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording of Post Earnings' Concall held on November 14, 2026
voiceSummary: Solex Energy Limited submitted the audio recording of its Post Earnings Conference Call held on November 14, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and the Bombay Stock Exchange Limited. The submission was made pursuant to Regulation 30 and Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The audio recording is available via a provided Google Drive link. Additionally, the link to the audio recording will be available on the company's website in compliance with Regulation 46 2 oa of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The communication was signed by Azmin Chiniwala, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, with membership number A68339.

attchmntText: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Solex Energy Limited published standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in the Financial Express on November 14, 2026. Apex Capital and Finance Limited reported net profit after tax of 147.37 lacs for the quarter and 283.05 lacs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 13, 2026. Command Polymers Limited reported a net loss after tax of 331.67 lacs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Kaizen Agro Infrabuild Limited reported net profit after tax of 1.58 lacs for the quarter and 19.89 lacs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Julien Agro Infratech Limited reported net profit after tax of 67.29 lacs for the quarter and 97.50 lacs for the half year ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Solex Energy Q2 FY27 Results: Strong Revenue Growth and Order Momentum; Subsidiary Approves Rupees 150 Crore CCD Issuance".
voiceSummary: Solex Energy Limited filed a press release on November 14, 2026, regarding its unaudited consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total revenue for Q2 FY27 was 2,743 million rupees, showing 75.8% year-over-year growth. EBITDA stood at 284 million rupees with a margin of 10.4%. Profit after tax was 39 million rupees, with earnings per share at 3.5. The company secured multiple work orders, including a major order worth 628.37 crore rupees. Order book visibility is reported at over 4,000 crore rupees. Additionally, the subsidiary Solex Green Energy Private Limited approved a 150 crore rupee compulsory convertible debenture issuance.

attchmntText: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Solex Energy Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported total income of 2,743 million rupees and EBITDA of 284 million rupees for Q2 FY27. Profit after tax was 39 million rupees. For H1 FY27, total income was 5,399 million rupees and EBITDA was 622 million rupees. The firm has a module manufacturing capacity of 4 GW. It is planning a 2.2 GW solar cell manufacturing line. The order book visibility stands at approximately 4,000 crore rupees. Dr. Chetan Shah serves as Chairman and Managing Director with DIN 02253886.

attchmntText: Solex Energy Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Solex Energy Limited announced the approval of its Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The financial statements include the operations of the holding company and three subsidiaries: Solex Green Energy Private Limited, Solex New Energy Private Limited, and Solex BESS Private Limited. Statutory auditors M/s Maheshwari & Co. issued a Limited Review Report with no modifications or qualifications. Solex Green Energy Private Limited reported revenue of Rs 212.22 million and profit of Rs 2.97 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company operates in the solar energy market, manufacturing modules and providing Engineering, Procurement, and Construction services. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange platforms.
